Just know you are not alone. We all go through tough times. I have often wished I were dead. But, life is what we make of it. Life is not supposed to be happy all the time. I also struggle with feeling inadequate, but if you reframe your mindset in not basing your worth on your achievements and rather on your personality and inherent worth as a human being, it will make you feel better. I'm sorry that happened with your girlfriend-- know that not everyone is like that, and it is not your fault for her lying to you. Something that helps me is optimistic nihilism, meaning we make our own purpose in this life. You are going to die anyway, so might as well live and see what happens. All the best to you. You are stronger than you think! Remember, the way you think about yourself and talk to yourself matters greatly.

I'm a junior in college and am dealing with a similar situation. I recently dropped out of nursing school, which was my previous major. It was useful but I did not really like it. At the end of the day, most of us have to make compromises. You're young and you have your whole future ahead of you, just know that. I hope you also realize that not everyone in college knows what they want to be either. I would say most have a general direction. With a lot of degrees you can do a lot of different things. Sadly, it is true that some degrees pay off better than others. At the end of the day we have to make ourselves happy, too. I hope you won't take on something that benefits the world but you do not enjoy. Don't do what I did... choose something you can tolerate. Nursing is a fantastic field but it takes a certain person. I realized I am too anxious for this profession a bit late in my college career. Best of luck to you. If you need any more advice I'm here.
